production."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Regulated New Jersey gas utility with appliance service plans, serving residential customers rather than producing gas."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Refines crude oil into transport fuels and sells retail and wholesale, a downstream refining business unlike business."},{"label":"C17","good":false,"reason":"Regulated electric and gas utility in New Mexico and Texas under state commissions, delivering to customers rather than producing gas."}]}
